prompt: Create a clean studio-style digital illustration of a whimsical rainbow crab on a plain white background, centered slightly left with lots of negative space. The crab is a cute semi-realistic 3D clay/soft-toy creature with smooth rounded forms, matte velvety surface, gentle ambient shadows, and pastel iridescent gradients blending cyan, teal, lime yellow, coral pink, lavender, violet, and orange across every body part. Show exactly 1 crab with a rounded oval carapace, 2 raised eyestalks with tiny dark glossy eyes, 2 large pincers, and 8 segmented walking legs. The left pincer is lifted high above the body in an open pose, larger and more vertical; the right pincer curves forward on the viewer’s right. The 8 legs are rounded bead-like segments with soft tapered pink-purple tips, arranged naturally beneath and around the shell. Add small mouth details under the front edge: 6 short soft appendages/tendrils in pastel pink, peach, and purple. Use a three-quarter front view, slightly from above, with the crab facing toward the lower left. Keep the style charming, polished, and tactile, like pastel polymer clay rendered with soft diffuse lighting. Add a small handwritten signature and date in the bottom-right corner reading July 30, 2026 Oyagi. No ocean, no sand, no props, no border, no extra animals, no text besides the signature.

promptZh: 创作一张简洁的工作室风格 3D 插图，展现一只置于纯白背景下的奇幻彩虹螃蟹。主体是一只可爱的玩具感螃蟹，拥有光滑圆润的外壳、柔软的粘土/毛绒质感、柔和的次表面散射阴影，以及融合了 青色、绿松石色、粉色、紫色、黄色、橙色和亮绿色 的柔和彩虹渐变。将其置于四分之三侧视图，身体居中，面朝左侧，周围留有大量空白。包含 2 只竖起的眼柄，配有深色光泽小眼睛；包含 2 只大钳子：左钳高高举起并张开，右钳位于前方较低位置且向内弯曲。包含 8 只分节的步行足，每侧 4 只，由圆润的胶囊状关节和锥形尖端组成，均采用不同的彩虹渐变色。在前方外壳下方添加一排小巧的圆润口器和短触须。使用柔和的写实光照、细腻的环境光遮蔽、足部下方极淡的接触阴影，呈现高分辨率的精致渲染效果，无场景、无道具、无边框。在右下角，添加一个小的手写艺术家签名和日期，内容为 2026 年 7 月 30 日 Oyagi，使用纤细的黑色墨水，不显突兀。
